about: The Aoaz bar (docs/specs/07_interface/01_interface.md section 2; design system docs/specs/07_interface/07_design_system.md, Banner Hall, section 6.4). Source of truth for its art sheets, its meters and the rows that pick a country's three meters. Built by tools/content/modules/ui.mjs (the Aoaz-bar part); jobs written by tools/content/art/aoaz-bar-jobs.mjs. UI overhaul lane W1.
style: Banner Hall appliqué: every item is one round emblem roundel cut from deep madder-red dyed wool (#850B0E), edged with a couched twisted gold cord (#FBE68F), with one flat appliqué symbol stitched on it in undyed linen, pale gold thread and woad blue wool. One bold symbol per roundel that still reads when the roundel is shown 24 pixels wide: a strong silhouette, few parts, no fine detail. Flat front view, the cloth weave visible only at close view, even soft light from the upper left. All roundels the same size.
